title: Grateful Dead Live at Seattle Center Arena on 1973-06-26

ai_review.summary: Warm, well‑balanced matrix recording of the June 26 1973 Seattle show with an expansive, high‑energy setlist.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a three‑plus hour performance that fans describe as a “great song selection” and an enjoyable listen when played loud or through headphones. As a matrix source it offers a pleasant blend of board clarity and audience ambience, though listeners note it benefits from some EQ tweaking. Overall the show is praised for its energy and variety despite the lack of specific song highlights in the reviews.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (5‑star) praise both the performance and the matrix recording; no technical complaints are raised, indicating a strong show with good sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, balanced sound that shines when played loudly or on headphones; listeners recommend using EQ to enhance clarity but report no drop‑outs or major issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: An extensive three‑hour set featuring over 30 tracks; reviewers highlight the strong song selection and high energy throughout, suggesting a well‑paced, engaging concert.
